authority: 2026-10-03 coordinator decision under delegated preregistration authority: add a training-only yaw candidate without changing B, r4 or frozen validator bytes.

training.v89_selection: Exactly input_manifest_r4.json raw, hash-verified. Zero nonzero turn ticks: audited but contributes no yaw fit windows.
training.v88_selection: calibration-unloaded, source 747d2b9f1eb43e21804ccef58fff4db241d1a844; signed steps+coasts and PRBS+coast, relative SIM seconds 242 to 326, robot r1.
training.frame_schema: pose/commands use t; frames use sim_time. No frames/images are needed or read for yaw fitting.

mean.family: sign-common gain, running tau, stop tau; three parameters per excited axis
mean.law: v_next=v+(1-exp(-dt/tau))*(gain*u-v); displacement=v_next*dt, as in the existing consumer. tau is running while any issued body command is nonzero, otherwise stop. Other-axis mean and cross gains are zero in an axis-only prediction, not fitted cross coupling.
mean.fit: Unweighted least squares of driven-component endpoint errors for all listed horizons, pooling all v89 step+stop and PRBS+stop windows. Positive log parameters, bounds gain [0.05,4], running tau [0.01,4] s, stop tau [0.005,0.5] s; initial [1,0.8,0.06].
mean.initial_state: Velocity starts at zero at recording start and is warmed ONLY by issued commands. Each window has an ideal start-pose fix. Measured velocity, future poses, contacts and simulator state are never predictor inputs.

fit.windows: Every 0.05 s start with a complete horizon within each signed step plus following coast, or the continuous PRBS plus following coast. Do not bridge these segments. Include onset, zero-command, reversal and stopping windows; do not thin or centre residuals. Gate every map/case/split separately, never pool away a failing group. Overlapping windows are descriptive, not independent samples.
fit.noise_propagation: Independent per-tick velocity noise contributes diag((sigma_velocity*dt)^2). Propagate pose covariance with first-order heading coupling in the start-pose frame, using the existing Euler consumer mean. No initial pose, scale_std, scale_walk, reset, measurement, roughening or map-prior covariance is credited. This is a linearized process budget, not a full PF posterior test.
fit.rotation_noise_solution: Pure-yaw mean has no translational heading Jacobian, but rotates body x/y noise. Vx=C*abs_x^2+S*abs_y^2, Vy=S*abs_x^2+C*abs_y^2, with C/S=sum(dt^2*cos/sin(pre-tick heading)^2). Minimize yaw quadratic, then forward allowing later left to increase, then left; group ceil(0.95*n) order statistics and 1e-12 slack only if inflated. Independently verify all coverage with frozen full-matrix Euler covariance.
fit.noise_scope: Yaw-only vector; original shared forward/left r4 vectors unchanged.
fit.identifiability: Both signed steps and signed PRBS, every horizon, optimizer success, Jacobian rank 3 and no parameter within 1e-4 log units of r4 bounds. Otherwise yaw stays null.

held_out.windows: Every 0.05 s start with a complete horizon within each signed step plus following coast, or the continuous PRBS plus following coast. Do not bridge these segments. Include onset, zero-command, reversal and stopping windows; do not thin or centre residuals. Gate every map/case/split separately, never pool away a failing group. Overlapping windows are descriptive, not independent samples.
held_out.axis_support: Both signed step and signed PRBS commands are required on that axis, and at least one complete window per horizon in each split. A missing split, missing frozen mean or insufficient horizon support gives null for the axis. Missing axes cannot yield an overall pass.

acceptance.p95_definition: Because sigma varies by window, p95(abs(error)/sigma) <= 2 (NumPy linear percentile). Also report p95 absolute error and sigma min/median/max in physical units; comparing two unrelated marginal percentiles is forbidden.
acceptance.overall: false if any validated axis fails; null if no failures but any axis is unvalidated; true only if all axes pass. Training reports always have null validation decisions.

held_out.requirements: Both maps, complete identity/source/schedule/command/pose audits and input hashes as in #356; use frozen evaluator, no pooling away any map/case/split/horizon/component failure. No refit, no fallback. Training/prior pose bytes ineligible. Malformed/incomplete inputs fail closed.
